text:
pr den 22t April 1803
Nachdem die Regierung zu Posen die wider den ehemaligen Starosten
Anton von Prusiemski und den Canonicus von Jezierski verhandelten Con¬
fiscations-Acten eingeschickt hat, verfehle ich nicht, solche Ew. Excellenz beige¬
hend in 6 Voluminibus, imgleichen das Concept zu dem, von des Königs Majestät
erforderten, gemeinschaftlichem Berichte, zu communiciren, mit dem ganz er¬
gebenstem Ersuchen, wenn dieselben gegen das Letztere nichts zu erinnern haben
sollten, solches gefälligst mitzuzeichnen, das Mundum anfertigen, und es zu mei¬
ner Mitunterschrift gelangen zu laßen, das Concept und die Acten aber ge¬
neigt an mich zu remittiren.
Berlin den 22ten April 1803.
Goldbeck
An
des Königln. würkl. Geheimen Staats-
Krieges-Cabinets- und dirigirenden
Finanz-Ministers Herrn Grafen von Haugwitz,
Excellenz

translation.en:
received 22 April 1803

The Government at Poznań having sent in the files of the confiscation proceedings against the former Starost Anton von Prusimski and the canon von Jezierski, I do not fail to communicate them to Your Excellency herewith in 6 volumes, together with the draft of the joint report required by His Majesty the King, with the most obedient request that, should you have nothing to remark against the latter, you kindly countersign it, have the fair copy made and sent to me for my co-signature, and be so good as to return the draft and the files to me.

Berlin, 22 April 1803.

Goldbeck

To His Royal Actual Privy State, War and Cabinet Minister and directing Minister of Finance, Count von Haugwitz, Excellency

text_english:
received 22 April 1803

The Government at Poznań having sent in the files of the confiscation proceedings against the former Starost Anton von Prusimski and the canon von Jezierski, I do not fail to communicate them to Your Excellency herewith in 6 volumes, together with the draft of the joint report required by His Majesty the King, with the most obedient request that, should you have nothing to remark against the latter, you kindly countersign it, have the fair copy made and sent to me for my co-signature, and be so good as to return the draft and the files to me.

Berlin, 22 April 1803.

Goldbeck

To His Royal Actual Privy State, War and Cabinet Minister and directing Minister of Finance, Count von Haugwitz, Excellency
summary_en: On 22 April 1803 Goldbeck sent Haugwitz the files of the confiscation proceedings against the former Starost Anton von Prusimski and the canon von Jezierski, which the Government at Poznań had sent in, in 6 volumes, with his draft of the joint report the King had asked for. If Haugwitz had no objection to the draft, he was to countersign it, have the fair copy made and sent to Goldbeck for his co-signature, and return the draft and the files.
summary_de: Goldbeck an Haugwitz, Berlin, 22. April 1803, eingegangen am selben Tag. Die Regierung zu Posen hat die Akten des Konfiskationsprozesses gegen den ehemaligen Starosten Anton von Prusimski und den Kanonikus von Jezierski eingeschickt; Goldbeck gibt sie in 6 Bänden weiter, mit seinem Konzept des vom König verlangten gemeinschaftlichen Berichts. Hat Haugwitz gegen das Konzept nichts einzuwenden, so soll er es mitzeichnen, die Reinschrift anfertigen und Goldbeck zur Mitunterschrift zugehen lassen und das Konzept und die Akten zurückgeben. Unterzeichnet Goldbeck.
